How to verify: Inspect guards, blade or cutter condition, alignment, power, extraction, and manufacturer-required setup.
Pass criteria: The machine is safe, stable, and appropriate for the operation.

How to verify: Mark the face, edge, fence, stop, datum, and feed direction used to locate the cut.
Pass criteria: Every part in the batch uses the same controlled references.

How to verify: Machine one representative part and measure it with the same method used at final inspection.
Pass criteria: Dimension, square, orientation, edge quality, and downstream fit all pass.

How to verify: Set a recheck frequency and stop rule for drift, damage, setup movement, or label mismatch.
Pass criteria: The batch cannot continue beyond a failed check without correction and a new first article.

How to verify: Check fence and blade relationship, blade height, throat insert, and applicable riving or guarding components.
Pass criteria: The setup is aligned and uses required safety equipment.

How to verify: Plan hand position, push devices, infeed, outfeed, and where each piece will move after separation.
Pass criteria: The operator can complete the cut without reaching into the hazard area.

How to verify: Test for size, parallelism, burning, chatter, and edge damage on representative stock.
Pass criteria: The process meets both dimension and surface requirements.
